displayGroups.description:
Adapts line height based on language script height.

Small – Latin, Greek, Cyrillic, Hebrew
Medium – Arabic, Hindi, Bangla, Malayalam, Tamil, Kannada, Gujarati, Punjabi, Odia, Sinhala, Japanese, Chinese, Korean, Thai, Lao, Khmer, Armenian, Amharic, etc.
Large – Burmese, Telugu
Extra Large – Nastaliq
